pages.text: $(l)Immersive Engineering$() is tech with a retro-industrial look: big multiblock machines wired together by $(l)overhead power lines$() on transformers and posts, rather than cables buried in a wall.$(br2)Its metals come out of the Arc Furnace and the Crusher.

The Arc Furnace and the Crusher are not crafting recipes, and IE's metals are mined, so both are priced by hand at $(l)Tier 2$() and $(l)Tier 3$().$(br2)Tier 3 is deliberately flat. Steel matches Tinkers' and Mekanism's steel exactly, so no pack can arbitrage one mod's steel into another's.
